relations.method: 第二轮人工风格复审：对全部已引用关系逐条重读证据原句，判断是否支持“关系类型+方向”。审核者仍为 Grok Bot（AI），非独立人类审核员；已对照 v0.3 结论并收紧弱证据。；并增补本轮年报原句新关系的逐条复审。

relationFailures.comment: ASML 20-F 仅称“visited TSMC…customers”，属客户关系暗示而非供货合同。保留但标 weak，不升 A。
relationFailures.quote: For example, in Decem ber 2024 we visited TSMC (Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Ltd.) in Taiwan in order to further build our understanding of our customers and how ASML can best meet their needs.

The complaint alleges that following our acquisition of Nuvia, we and Nuvia breached Nuvia’s Architecture License Agreement with Arm (the Nuvia ALA) by failing to comply with the termination obligations under the Nuvia ALA.
relationFailures.comment: 原句为 Nuvia 架构授权协议诉讼，未直接证明 Arm→高通 授权（间接）

relationFailures.quote: We typically receive semiconductor products from our subcontractors, perform incoming quality assurance and configuration using test equipment purchased from industry-leading suppliers such as Advantest America Inc. and Chroma ATE Inc., and then ship the semiconductors to contract manufacturers, such as BYD Auto and Hon Hai, distributors, motherboard and add-in card, or AIC, customers from our third-party warehouses in Hong Kong, Israel, and the United States.
relationFailures.comment: 原句未体现英伟达向比亚迪供货（比亚迪在英伟达 10-K 中是代工分包方，方向相反）

relationFailures.comment: 原句为“partnerships with … Volkswagen”，未明确供货。降为待核实。
relationFailures.quote: In 2018, Mobileye announced partnerships with BMW, Nissan and Volkswagen.

relationFailures.comment: 所引 Wikipedia 句讲的是 GlobalFoundries/UMC，未提及 Samsung 为竞争者。证据不支持，降级。
relationFailures.quote: While the competitors in the foundry industry (primarily GlobalFoundries and United Microelectronics Corporation) have encountered difficulties ramping leading-edge 28 nm capacity, the leading integrated device manufacturers such as Samsung and Intel that seek to offer foundry capacity to third parties were also unable to match the requirements for advanced mobile applications.

relationFailures.comment: 原句讲 1990s 合同，过于陈旧。降为待核实，除非另有近三年证据。
